_comment: Per-source import config for the catalog conversion pipeline. The app's CatalogModelLoader.fitTransform re-centers and per-axis-stretches every model to the catalog's real dimensions, so ABSOLUTE scale here is informational only — what matters is correct UP-AXIS (model Y must be up) and sane proportions. Prefer glTF input wherever a source ships it: glTF is Y-up by spec, which removes all axis ambiguity. The 'axis' block is only consulted for obj/fbx inputs; the bbox report from convert_to_usdz.py is the ground-truth check that orientation came out right.

quaternius.scale_note: Modeled in arbitrary game units; app re-scales so this does not matter. Validate proportions only.

kenney.scale_note: Small kit-bash scale; app re-scales. Validate proportions only.

ithappy.scale_note: Advertised real-world scale; useful as the proportion reference even though the app re-scales.

_test.scale_note: Synthetic testbox_zup.obj: X=1 Y=2 Z=3 authored Z-up. Correct output bbox must read X=1.0, Y=3.0, Z=2.0 (the 3.0 tall axis moved Z->Y).
